cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import json, time, random, itertools
# worst-case output size / serialization cost for the maximal rule count
rules=[]
rng=random.Random(0)
for size in (1,2,3,4):
    for clause in itertools.combinations(range(32), size):
        rules.append({'clause':list(clause),'witnesses':[rng.randrange(10000) for _ in clause],'counterexample':rng.randrange(65536)})
print('rules', len(rules))
t0=time.time()
rules.sort(key=lambda r:(len(r['clause']), r['clause']))
raw=json.dumps({'results':[{'rules':rules,'active':[],'answers':[]} for _ in range(2)]},separators=(',',':'))
print('sort+dumps', round(time.time()-t0,3),'s bytes', len(raw))
"
